description: Stations de vélo en libre service (VélO2 et Cristolib) - Disponibilités en temps réel is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Les informations Vélib ne sont plus disponibles suite au changement d'opérateur (Smoove). Nous travaillons avec le syndicat mixte Vélib' Métropole pour vous proposer à nouveau ce service. En attendant, pour consulter la disponibilité vélib: cliquez ici. Ce jeu de données donne les disponibilités en temps réel des stations Cristolib (Créteil) et VélO2 (Cergy Pontoise). Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Vélos & Nouvelles mobilités. Its keywords are Vélo, Temps réel. The portal shows 2018-01-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open License v1.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
